title: Capture evaluation sample manifest
description: Describes a directory of REAL, labelled sample images for capture/evaluation/harness.js (capture/evaluation/fixtures/realSamples.js loads it). This directory is opt-in and gitignored (capture/evaluation/fixtures/real/): nothing here is committed automatically, because sample images can be private. Synthetic fixtures (tests/support/captureFixtures.js) are separate and always clearly labelled synthetic in their own metadata.

image.description: Path to the sample image, relative to this manifest file.

crs.description: Optional project CRS code to validate plausibility against, e.g. EPSG:7801.

metadata.description: Describes the sample so aggregate reports can be sliced (e.g. handwriting accuracy only).

rows.description: One entry per table row, in the order it is printed. Only the fields present are checked (see capture/evaluation/harness.js valueMatches).

rawText.description: Optional: expected OCR text per field, for exact-text accuracy (independent of the numeric value).
